fix_summary: Two bugs in shared MC kernel (aof_cfr/trio_eval_mc.py): (1) native OMPEval eval7 ranks higher=better but kernel selected lower=better, inverting winners when hu_table_native routed MC; (2) custom LCG index draw (state % rem) produced non-uniform board samples with ~0.7-1.7% systematic bias on rank-collision deals. Live-deck construction was already correct (46 cards, distinct, disjoint for 22/22/33 probe). Fix: always use numba _eval7 for n-way MC; partial Fisher-Yates board draw via np.random.randint.

before_after_4max_collision.note: Stage 1 clean spots (four distinct pairs) were not collision tests; this deal has paired-rank overlap.
